concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Across X one continuous crest with small natural height and plan sinuosity. Wind travels +Y; stoss from Y=-52 to crest nearY=9, slipface toY=34: ramp run61 versus slipface25 for nominal height14.5, about13deg versus30deg. Sand cutaway extends windward and leeward. No painted bands, repetitive surface tiles, vegetation or barchan horns. Different structure from batch70 long narrow near-symmetric linear dune; no copied geometry. Concept inspected: asymmetry and continuous slipface are usable; reduce concept steep near-vertical look to approximately angle-of-repose30degrees with no regular sawtooth crest.
